contract: TASK-120 scope context and epochs (plan §3.4, SN1, S12, F13)
legacy_rule: A unit with exactly one active eligible source whose source.max_profile and channel.max_profile are both NULL uses the legacy NULL context: one DEMO-REDUCED variant, legacy digest, legacy endpoints.
profile_rule: Channel profiles are those with rank <= min(channel.max_profile, source.max_profile); NULL counts as DEMO-REDUCED. Channels sorted by id.
hash_function: apps.reports.canonical.digest (sha256 of sort_keys, compact separators, UTF-8)

epochs.Organization.policy_epoch: bigint >= 0; +1 per policy activate/deactivate; covers every unit
epochs.Unit.scope_epoch: bigint >= 0; +1 per scope change affecting that unit only
epochs.trigger: BEFORE UPDATE rejects decrease and any increase other than exactly +1
epochs.validity: current only if job.policy_epoch == org.policy_epoch and job.scope_epoch == unit.scope_epoch
epochs.no_revival: earlier epochs never become current again (D6)

topology_writer_FN1: scopes/services.py is the sole supported writer of ChannelSource, SharingChannel.max_profile, SharingChannel.active and Unit.active. Deactivating or reactivating a channel is a scope change for every unit with a source on that channel.
